items.title: Pocketpair Gives Staff Five Days Off for GTA 6
items.summary: Palworld developer Pocketpair grants staff who plan to play GTA 6 special leave from 19-23 November, and says Palworld and Craftopia work stays on.
items.content:
Palworld’s developer has framed five days of special leave as an urgent business trip to Vice City.

0:00 Pocketpair, the studio behind Palworld , is giving staff who plan to play Grand Theft Auto 6 five days of special leave around the game’s launch. Insider Gaming reports that the announcement came from the official Palworld account on X, which styled the time off as an urgent business trip to Vice City. The studio says the break won’t affect its live games.

According to VGTimes , the leave runs from 19 to 23 November 2026, starting on the day GTA 6 launches worldwide. That’s a Thursday to a Monday, so the window includes a weekend. The post says the leave applies to employees who intend to play the game, and it points readers to an attached notice for details.

In a post on X, the Palworld account wrote that all Pocketpair employees “have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City”.

All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches. Please see the attached notice for details. pic.twitter.com/qJjJ7IvhhY

Pocketpair also moved to head off the obvious worry. The studio says work on Palworld and Craftopia is proceeding smoothly and is expected to hit its planned schedule, so players shouldn’t expect the break to delay updates. That makes the leave a perk for staff that leaves the roadmap untouched.

Palworld fans took to the post with enthusiasm. Insider Gaming says one commenter called it a “Common Pocketpair W”, which is about as formal as a labour-policy review gets on social media.

Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.

According to VGTimes, Pocketpair has done this before, giving staff time off for Elden Ring and Monster Hunter Wilds . A big-release holiday is therefore closer to a habit than a one-off stunt, and it fits a studio that has leaned into jokes about itself and its competitors.

Pocketpair isn’t the only employer to see the launch coming. As we reported, Logitech is giving roughly 7,000 employees a day off to play games , with a year-long window to use it. The two schemes differ in scale. Logitech’s benefit is a flexible allowance that staff can use on any game, while Pocketpair’s is a fixed block of five days timed to a single release.

Insider Gaming expects GTA 6 to sell tens of millions of copies in its first week and to prompt millions of workers to take a day off or call in sick. If that’s right, Pocketpair has simply made the absence official instead of leaving staff to invent the symptoms.

The post says all employees have been granted the leave, and it directs those who intend to play GTA 6 to an attached notice for the details.

Pocketpair says no. The studio says work on both games is proceeding smoothly and is expected to stay on schedule.

It launches worldwide on 19 November 2026, the first day of Pocketpair’s five-day leave.

items.title: Palworld Dev Gives Employees an Official GTA6 Vacation Week
items.summary: Pocketpair saved everyone the trouble of calling in sick by giving its employees five days to enjoy GTA6.
items.content:
We are officially… let me check my calendar here… one week out from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 . The hatches are being battened down, evacuations are underway, toilet paper is sold out across the world. We’re looking at a Category 5-hype video game release here, and everyone waits with bated breath for the moment to arrive.

For about as long as the game’s official release date has been known, prospective players have been planning their time off, whether they get it formally approved by their employers, or they just plan to spontaneously develop a virulent cold and call in sick. Offices, schools, and just about every other public place will be virtually empty as the world screeches to a halt on November 19.

Grand Theft Auto 6 is releasing exactly one day before the official nomination cutoff date for the 2026 Game Awards.

With all that in mind, if everyone is going to take time off or sick days anyway, the sporting thing to do would be to just make it official. This is the avenue that the developer of popular creature-collect and crafting survival game Palworld , Pocketpair, is taking with its employees; as the company announced in a tweet on the official Palworld X, formerly Twitter account , everyone working for it will be getting five days off from work for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

As the tweet on the Palworld account reads, “All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches.”

This was followed by an image showing a statement on what I’m assuming is official Pocketpair company stationary, which reads, “on November 19, millions of gamers around the world will find themselves sitting at school or work, gazing longingly out the window, knowing that a new era of gaming is about to begin.”

“At Pocketpair, we believe that such a historic occasion deserves our full attention.”

All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches.

The note then announces that all employees who intend to play Grand Theft Auto 6 will be granted a special five-day holiday running from Thursday, November 19 to Monday, November 23, which also provides enough time to fly to Miami for the game's big release festival . The note adds that only those who intend to actually play GTA6 are eligible for this time off, though considering the nature of this break, I kind of doubt that’ll actually be enforced.

The note also adds, presumably for the sake of end users, that update work for Palworld and Craftopia is currently on schedule and will be carried out as normal.

Logitech wants employees to reap the personal and professional benefits of gaming.

The note concludes with a well-wish for employees, reading, “we hope everyone enjoys their time away from the office and returns safely from their travels.”

This is a very sporting thing for Pocketpair to do, not to mention a pretty amusing way to go about it. Honestly, though, it would probably behoove many companies in the game industry, and indeed, the entire United States business sector, to follow suit.

When I said before that the world will grind to a halt on November 19, that wasn’t an exaggeration. Last month, an economics professor at Pompeu Fabra University in Barcelona, José García Montalvo, spoke to the International Business Times , providing an estimate of how much money the U.S. economy will lose due to people taking vacation, calling in sick, or otherwise skipping work on GTA6 release day. With a rough estimate of 1.5 million absences, based on an average annual income of $70,000, Montalvo ballparks that this single day will cost the U.S. economy roughly $1 billion in lost productivity.

items.title: Palworld Dev Gives All Employees a GTA 6 Holiday Lasting Five Days
items.summary: Pocketpair, the developer behind Palworld, has given all employees five days off to play Grand Theft Auto 6 next week.
items.content:
Pocketpair, the developer behind the sensational monster-catching game, Palworld, has announced a ‘special five-day holiday’ on social media. This is in recognition of the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, which comes out globally on November 19th.

In the post on social media, the team explained that all employees who intend to play GTA 6 when it comes out can take advantage of the special leave period. It was also promised that Palworld and Craftopia work is proceeding smoothly and is expected to be carried out as scheduled, which gets ahead of the naysayers claiming the break would pose a danger to those games.

The utter win of a post on social media that promised a five-day holiday for Pocketpair employees was met with solid positivity from Palworld fans. One wrote in the comments under the post, ‘Common Pocketpair W.’

All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches. Please see the attached notice for details. pic.twitter.com/qJjJ7IvhhY

In a similar move, Logitech revealed a global holiday allowance that permitted all employees to take one day off in the next year to play video games. Coincidentally, they dropped that deal just a week or so before the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, and said that if that’s the day folks want to take off, they’ve got no qualms.

Grand Theft Auto 6 is expected to be a record-setting title, shifting tens of millions of copies in the first week on the market. It’s also expected to see millions of workers take a day off or go sick to play it, so there’s that.

Are you taking the day off work to play Grand Theft Auto 6? Let us know your plans on the Insider Gaming Discord server .

For more Insider Gaming coverage, check out the recent first-person GTA 6 clip posted by Rockstar , and don’t forget to sign up for our free weekly newsletter

Grant has been gaming for 30+ years and in the industry for 10+. You'll probably find him playing a post-apocalyptic game or an extraction shooter somewhere.

items.title: [7803.T FY2027 Q1 Earnings Call] Bushiroad Raises Full-Year Forecast as Palworld OCG Global Shipments Top 11 Million Packs, Revenue Seen at ¥71 Billion
items.summary: Bushiroad reported first-quarter results for the fiscal year ending June 2027. Revenue jumped ¥3.182 billion year-on-year to ¥16.948 billion…
items.content:
Add preferred source Bushiroad reported first-quarter results for the fiscal year ending June 2027. Revenue jumped ¥3.182 billion year-on-year to ¥16.948 billion (approximately $106.1 million), but operating profit fell ¥122 million to ¥1.546 billion (approximately $9.7 million), producing a revenue-up, profit-down result. The core TCG segment surged ¥3.174 billion to ¥10.135 billion (approximately $63.5 million), driven by the successful simultaneous global launch of the Palworld Official Card Game. Cumulative booster pack shipments surpassed 11 million packs in early November, and tutorial session participants reached 24,123. Meanwhile, higher advertising and promotion spending for the Palworld OCG and BanG Dream! Our Notes squeezed margins. Digital games underperformed initial expectations due to unauthorized access and early bugs, but a full contribution is expected from the second quarter onward. The company raised its full-year forecast to ¥71 billion (approximately $444.5 million) in revenue, ¥6.6 billion (approximately $41.3 million) in operating profit, ¥7.1 billion (approximately $44.5 million) in ordinary profit, and ¥5.1 billion (approximately $31.9 million) in net profit. It also plans a total dividend of ¥4 per share, including a ¥1 commemorative dividend for its 20th anniversary. Key Elements Bushiroad Palworld Official Card Game BanG Dream! Our Notes BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! Cardfight!! Vanguard Weiss Schwarz Palverse Bushiroad The Box Tectomo Mirsarge Ikkadan Stardom Malaysia Kazakhstan Nemoto Bushiroad Posts Sharp Revenue Growth on Palworld OCG, Raises Full-Year Forecast Bushiroad (7803.T) on November 12, 2026 reported first-quarter results for the fiscal year ending June 2027 (July-September 2026), with revenue jumping ¥3.182 billion year-on-year to ¥16.948 billion (approximately $106.1 million). Operating profit, however, came in at ¥1.546 billion (approximately $9.7 million), down ¥122 million (approximately $760,000), while ordinary profit was ¥1.441 billion (approximately $9.0 million), down ¥491 million (approximately $3.1 million), and quarterly net profit attributable to parent shareholders was ¥1.091 billion (approximately $6.8 million), down ¥572 million (approximately $3.6 million) — a revenue-up, profit-down quarter.

At the outset of the earnings briefing, President Nemoto said, "Trading card games in particular grew significantly on the contribution of the Palworld Official Card Game and are performing strongly," underscoring the rapid growth of the core business.

The main driver of the profit decline was higher advertising and promotion spending tied to the launches of the Palworld OCG and BanG Dream! Our Notes. "Advertising and promotion expenses increased with the launches of the Palworld Official Card Game and BanG Dream! Our Notes, which is a factor pushing down the profit margin," President Nemoto explained. In the MD (merchandise) business as well, he said, "Rising energy costs and other factors amid the global situation are weighing on the profit margin, but we are advancing measures such as price revisions," revealing that the company is moving to address cost pressures.

The TCG segment surged to ¥10.135 billion (approximately $63.5 million) in revenue, up ¥3.174 billion (approximately $19.9 million) year-on-year. The Palworld Official Card Game was released simultaneously worldwide on July 30, 2026 in three languages — Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese — and President Nemoto said it "got off to a strong start." Cumulative global shipments of the first and second booster packs combined surpassed 11 million packs in early November.

Tutorial sessions are being held around the world, with cumulative participants reaching 24,123. "By continuing to run tournaments, including officially sanctioned events and world championships, we will work to retain customers and aim to establish a medium- to long-term earnings base," President Nemoto said, emphasizing the building of an ecosystem that goes beyond simply selling cards.

Overseas revenue came to ¥5.515 billion (approximately $34.5 million), up ¥2.477 billion year-on-year, driven largely by the English-language version of the Palworld OCG. To meet demand, the company decided to expand production lines at a manufacturing plant of a group company in Malaysia.

Cardfight!! Vanguard is also performing well, with a completely new 15th-anniversary TV anime, "Veilrift," scheduled to air in 2027. Booster packs in Japanese and English versions will be released simultaneously starting with the new series.

Digital Games revenue fell ¥178 million (approximately $1.1 million) year-on-year to ¥1.315 billion (approximately $8.2 million). Regarding BanG Dream! Our Notes, released worldwide on September 24, 2026, President Nemoto explained, "Due in part to early unauthorized access and initial bugs, we expect it to make a full contribution to earnings from the second quarter onward."

In the Q&A session, he apologized: "I am truly sorry for the inconvenience caused to customers by the initial unauthorized access and the early bugs." While noting that "we are now able to operate stably," he revealed efforts toward improvement, saying, "We are currently getting to work on fixing the bugs, improving the experience, and developing new features."

Meanwhile, the existing title BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! performed well compared with the previous quarter. It will mark its 10th anniversary in March 2027.

Live Entertainment revenue was ¥2.284 billion (approximately $14.3 million), up ¥593 million (approximately $3.7 million) year-on-year. Live events and CD products from the BanG Dream! project performed well, and Stardom was consolidated starting this fiscal year. The BanG Dream! 13th Live was held in the second quarter. In October 2026, the company held its first fashion event, "Bushiroad Fashion Journey," at Shibuya Hikarie, advancing the development of new customer touchpoints.

MD revenue was ¥2.646 billion (approximately $16.6 million), up ¥624 million (approximately $3.9 million) year-on-year. The figure brand Palverse surpassed 6 million packs in cumulative production (as of November 2026). The box toy brand Bushiroad The Box drove sales, mainly through overseas shipments, and the plush toy "Puchish" also performed well. The company launched a new brand, Tectomo, and President Nemoto said the first product, slated for release in January 2027, got off to "a very strong start," mainly on overseas orders. The company is also pursuing new markets, including exhibiting at an event in Kazakhstan.

The company raised its full-year earnings forecast.

"The Palworld Official Card Game got off to a stronger start than expected immediately after launch. We have reflected that performance and revised our shipment outlook going forward, incorporating both into this earnings forecast," President Nemoto explained. As for BanG Dream! Our Notes, he said, "We expect it to make a full contribution to earnings from the second quarter onward."

The Sunlit Isle (405, -483) Pros: Several crude oil nodes, easy to defend during raids Cons: No nearby ore Closest teleport: Sunlit Isle It's not the best spot for ore or stone, but the Sunlit Isle just east of Palworld's starting area makes early game crude oil farming a breeze with six nodes scattered across the land. It's not difficult to defend, and the pals living here are under level 10. I like building at the highest point along the island's south side, but there's a cute spot northeast with stone steps leading up to it that works just as well. Even if you intend to go elsewhere for ore farming, this is a great place to build a second base for a steady crude oil supply.

items.summary: \ Palworld version v1.0.3 has been released! ＝＝＝ \ ▼Items and Equipment ・Changed the unlock level of some Jetragon-related technologies from 79 to 70, and reduced the materials required for the Pal Gear used to ride Jetragon. ・Changed the t
items.content:
\

Palworld version v1.0.3 has been released!

＝＝＝

\

▼Items and Equipment ・Changed the unlock level of some Jetragon-related technologies from 79 to 70, and reduced the materials required for the Pal Gear used to ride Jetragon.

・Changed the technology unlock level of the Aquatic Construction Kit from Level 66 to Level 23, changed its Ancient Technology Point requirement from 4 to 1, and adjusted the required materials and work amount.

・Extended the duration of World Tree Holy Water.

・Reduced the weight of World Tree Holy Water from 1 to 0.1.

・Added World Tree Holy Water to the rewards for World Tree expeditions, World Tree fishing, and the Large Fishing Pond.

・Increased the amount of World Tree Holy Water obtained from Pals in The World Tree area.

・Increased the amount of World Tree Holy Water obtained from Teafant Spring.

・Adjusted the work amount required to craft the Ancient Armor series.

・Doubled the amount of Fiber obtained from trees.

▼Bases and Missions

・Reduced the building costs of the Crude Oil Extractor, High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor, and Large Power Generator.

・Increased the crude oil production speed of the Crude Oil Extractor and High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor.

・The base mission that requires building a Crude Oil Extractor can now also be progressed by building a High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor.

▼Server Settings

・Added a server setting (bAllowEnemyCampSpawnNearBaseCamp) that disables the suppression of enemy camp spawns near player base camps.

\

▼Graphics and Display

・Adjusted the boundary display in some areas to make it easier to see from a distance.

・Improved the display quality of some objects in dungeons.

▼Sound

・Added a sound effect when using World Tree Holy Water.

\

▼Crashes and Progression Blockers

・Fixed an issue where the mission could become impossible to progress if the barrier was removed before accepting the main mission in Sunreach.

▼Multiplayer and Co-op

・Fixed an issue in co-op where lighting on the client side could display incorrectly after cutscenes or the ending played.

・Fixed an issue in co-op where some scenes could stutter during the cutscene that plays when entering The World Tree.

・Fixed an issue on dedicated servers where Fast Travel could activate unintentionally during Tower Boss battles.

・Fixed an issue on dedicated servers where Pals could appear to vibrate rapidly on the client screen.

▼Pals and NPCs

・Fixed an issue where the summoned Pal could stop fighting.

・Fixed an issue where the summoned Pal could stop helping with base work.

・Fixed an issue in multiplayer where, when the Partner Skill of Orserk or certain other Pals activated, the effect display could fail to update correctly, making it appear as though the skill had not activated.

・Fixed an issue where Alpha Surfent would not produce Leather when assigned to a Ranch.

▼Battles and Bosses

・Fixed an issue where some raid boss battles could fail to progress as intended.

・Fixed an issue where the wave effect and actual damage range did not match for some of Panthalus's attacks.

▼Bases and Building

・Fixed an issue where the placement detection for stairs and slanted roofs could fail to match their actual shape.

・Fixed an issue where stairs could not be placed correctly on the sides of foundations or roofs.

▼Items and Rewards

・Fixed an issue where the reward settings for the normal Moon Lord battle and the Ultra Raid Boss battle had not been updated to the intended settings.

・Fixed an issue where items could duplicate when performing certain actions.

・Fixed an issue where, when Katress's Partner Skill activated, switching spheres while riding could allow the player to obtain a different type of sphere.

・Fixed an issue where the World Tree Holy Water effect did not display correctly on the Pal being ridden when using World Tree Holy Water while riding.

・Fixed an issue where, after the World Tree Holy Water effect ended, riding a Pal would cause the World Tree Holy Water aura to reappear and not disappear when approaching trees in The World Tree area.

・Fixed an issue where an unintended reward was set for the desert expedition.

・Fixed an issue where the Dark Skill Fruit: Psycho Gravity did not appear on the item search screen.

・Fixed a bug where the firing interval was not set for sphere launchers

▼UI, Display, and Text

・Fixed an issue where resolution settings would not apply correctly in fullscreen mode.

・Fixed an issue where, after switching window mode with F11 / Alt+Enter, the game could unintentionally return to fullscreen mode after loading.

・Fixed an issue where, if certain effects were on screen while aiming, the entire screen could become blurred.

▼Sound

・Fixed an issue where the water sound effect could fail to play at Teafant Spring.

・Fixed an issue on dedicated servers where the BGM for Attack Choppers triggered by other players could play even from far away.

・Adjusted the BGM playback range for Attack Choppers so that it plays correctly for players who are Wanted.

・Fixed an issue where unintended footstep sounds could play when walking on furniture or facilities.

▼Controls

・Fixed an issue where, after changing the key assignment for ""Attack that enemy!"" in Controls, selecting ""Restore to Default"" would not restore the default setting.

・Fixed an issue where settings could be applied unintentionally when interacting with the change confirmation dialog and duplicate key warning in Controls.

▼Map and Exploration

・Fixed an issue where a beach-like display could remain on the water surface after Fast Traveling to an offshore base.

＝＝＝

Thank you for your continued support of Palworld.

items.title: v1.0.2: Bug fixes
items.summary: \ Palworld version v1.0.2 has been released! This update includes improvements to gameplay stability and fixes for various issues. ＝＝＝ ▼Crashes and Disconnections ・Fixed an issue where all players could be disconnected during the Panthalus
items.content:
\

Palworld version v1.0.2 has been released!

This update includes improvements to gameplay stability and fixes for various issues.

＝＝＝

▼Crashes and Disconnections

・Fixed an issue where all players could be disconnected during the Panthalus battle on dedicated servers.

・Fixed an issue where players could crash during the Panthalus battle on dedicated servers.

・Fixed an issue where the game could crash when attempting Japanese text input in fullscreen mode.

▼Multiplayer

・Fixed an issue where, if a player was already in The World Tree area when the host transitioned to The World Tree area, the terrain could fail to display correctly from the host’s perspective.

・Fixed an issue where the Tower Boss “Victor & Shadowbeak” could disappear after using a teleportation attack during battle.

・Fixed an issue in the final boss battle where, if the host defeated the final boss while a guest was waiting to respawn, the guest’s light could fail to display correctly after respawning.

▼Missions

・Fixed an issue in the main mission “The First Islander” where the screen could remain faded out if dialogue was interrupted during a fade-out sequence.

・Fixed an issue in the sub-mission “Captured Adventurer” where the screen could remain faded out if dialogue was interrupted during a fade-out sequence.

▼Achievements

・Fixed an issue where the “Predator Hunter” achievement could fail to unlock even after meeting its requirements.

・Fixed an issue where the corresponding achievement could fail to unlock even after obtaining the required Pal Effigies.

・Fixed an issue on Xbox where the icons for two Lifmunk Effigy-related achievements were using outdated versions.

▼Graphics and Display

・Fixed an issue where the eye area of the player model could display incorrectly during cutscenes or certain player actions when using specific face types.

▼Controls

・Added key rebinding for "Attack that enemy!" and "Inventory".

・Fixed an issue where, when carrying over settings from versions earlier than v0.7, changes unrelated to Controls could still be treated as control setting conflicts.

・Fixed an issue where assigning a player action to the middle mouse button could incorrectly be treated as a conflict, preventing the setting from being applied.

・Fixed an issue where the Inventory Shortcut option was not displayed in Controls.

▼UI

・Fixed an issue where the damage number displayed when destroying ore while mining could sometimes appear as 0.

▼Performance Improvements

・Reduced the processing load during gameplay in Sunreach and improved performance.

＝＝＝

Thank you for your continued support of Palworld.

items.title: Palworld Has Now Outsold Almost Every Mainline Pokémon Game
items.summary: Palworld has reportedly sold 30.5 million copies, surpassing almost every mainline Pokémon game, including Scarlet and Violet
items.content:
Palworld has reportedly sold 30.5 million copies, surpassing almost every mainline Pokémon game, including Scarlet and Violet

X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount{ display:none; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount .discount-tag{ line-height: 24px !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button.most-popular .join-now-button:hover { background: #000 !important; color: #fff !important; outline: 1px solid #fff !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button:hover { background: 0 0; outline: 1px solid rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); color: rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); } @media (max-width: 1220px){ .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button { width: 100% !important; position: unset !important; } } A new report claims that Palworld has sold a staggering 30.5 million units. If accurate, Pocketpair’s controversial survival game has now outsold almost every mainline Pokémon release, including Scarlet and Violet , Sword and Shield , and Gold and Silver .

According to a new report from Alinea Analytics, Palworld has now sold an estimated 30.5 million units across Xbox, PlayStation, and PC . The video game market intelligence firm also estimates that Pocketpair has generated an eye-watering $700 million in total revenue following the recent launch of Palworld 1.0.

If these latest estimates are accurate, they also mean that Palworld has now significantly outsold many of the biggest Pokémon releases over the last 30 years. In Nintendo’s most recent financial report , for example, Pokémon Scarlet and Violet only sold a combined 28.08 million units on Nintendo Switch in comparison.

However, it’s bigger than that, as Palworld has also outsold most classic Pokémon generation titles such as Gold and Silver and Gen 4’s Diamond and Pearl . Here is a full breakdown of the sales figures:

Now, there are a few factors we need to point out here. Since its launch in 1996, the mainline Pokémon series has remained exclusive to Nintendo consoles. One major advantage Palworld has is that it’s an addictive creature-catcher available across most major gaming platforms.

Alinea Analytics points out that while Palworld generated most of its revenue on PC via Steam, it also sold millions of units on PlayStation 5. The game is additionally available on Xbox and through Game Pass, giving it access to a much larger potential audience than an individual Pokémon release.

However, while Palworld has many Pokémon games beat in terms of units sold, Nintendo’s series likely generates more revenue per copy. Pokémon games typically retail for $60 to $70 at launch, while Palworld originally entered early access for $29.99 and has frequently been discounted.

Finally, Nintendo does not update Pokémon sales figures every month, meaning Scarlet and Violet has almost certainly sold additional copies since its last reported total. It’s therefore possible that the Gen 9 games are closer to Palworld than the currently available figures suggest.

Regardless, selling an estimated 30.5 million copies is an incredible achievement for a new IP that only recently debuted in 2024. Palworld is now only around 880,000 units behind Pokémon Red, Green, and Blue , which remains the best-selling mainline Pokémon generation of all time.
